about: The read replay's correction turns (slice 0022). Each is the participant reply in which a vignette's laterSays was delivered, found by reading the transcript once. shape 'settled': the criterion had a settled answer when the correction came, which is what the slice measures. 'unrecorded': the first answer never reached the criterion. 'held-back': the first answer was held open as hedged, and the correction came on its own follow-up. Only 'settled' turns count toward the gate's bar; the others are reported.
